description:
Implement the integration between project-wiki and Knowledge Observatory so wiki content is searchable via KO's semantic search. This follows Karpathy's LLM Wiki model (https://gist.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f/raw/ac46de1ad27f92b28ac95459c782c07f6b8c964a/llm-wiki.md) where the wiki layer sits between raw sources and query — KO provides the semantic query capability over wiki content.

When wiki pages are created or updated, the project-wiki scenario publishes them to KO using KO's existing ingest API (POST /api/v1/knowledge/documents/ingest for chunked documents or POST /api/v1/knowledge/records/upsert for individual records).

Implementation:
- Define a KO namespace for wiki content (e.g., "project-wiki")
- After any wiki page create/update, call KO's ingest endpoint to embed the updated content
- After wiki page deletion, call KO's delete endpoint to remove corresponding records
- The project-wiki publish CLI command does a full re-sync: ingests all wiki pages into KO
- KO's existing semantic search then works over wiki content alongside scenario docs
- Handle KO being unavailable gracefully (wiki still works, just without semantic search; queue re-sync for when KO comes back)

KO already has the full embedding pipeline (Ollama nomic-embed-text → Qdrant 768-dim vectors), document chunking (1200 chars, 150 overlap), and search API. This work wires into that existing infrastructure.
name: project-wiki-ko-integration
title: Wire Wiki Content Publishing To Knowledge Observatory
